notes: PROVISIONAL: desktop occlusion unverified; geometry/screenshots reviewed separately.
CPU is driver process CPU percent; POWER is macOS top POWER score, not watts; RSS is end MiB.
Main = perf.update_ms (First-to-Last); allocs/bytes are per frame, total across threads vs main.
FPS/frames belong only to the perf window; GPU is a separate trace, not GPU ms/frame or framecount.
GPU total is union of exact-PID Active intervals at ALL depths over TOC duration; unknown PIDs excluded.
Depth-zero union and summed interval durations are diagnostics, not total GPU busy; overlaps count once in the total.
Optional pass statistics count labeled GPU intervals, not frames, drawcalls, vertices or GPU cycles.
